author: Xyla Foxlin
description:
In honor of missing the red carpet at the Webby awards this summer and then being out of town when the mailed award finally arrived, I pulled a little “but we have webbys at home!” 

What an honor to be recognized as the Social Impact Creator of the Year by @thewebbyawards for my advocacy work on behalf of @pilotmentalhealth campaign. I share this with @longhaulfilms for their exceptional storytelling of the work we’ve done. And what great timing as the Mental Health in Aviation Act and Aviation Medication Transparency Act make their way through the Senate!!

The Webbys famously have the 5 word acceptance speech, and my submission was “Be fearless enough to speak”. Something I’ve lost a lot of sleep over in the last year is trying to come up with was to inspire other creators to use their platforms for good and speak up for what they believe in, despite the fear of pushback or rejection from our audiences. My team and I have for sure gotten lots of hate and pushback for this campaign,
title: Missed the Webby Awards but it’s okay, we have Webbys at home 😂
